name: 45204 · Cincinnati, OH
findings: ZIP 45204 (Cincinnati) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45204 (Cincinnati) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 45204 (Cincinnati) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
